ayahs.translation: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement,
(a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers, one which none can avert;
a chastisement from Allah, the Lord of the ascending steps,

ayahs.arabicText: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَ الرُّوْحُ اِلَیْهِ فِیْ یَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗ خَمْسِیْنَ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍۚ
ayahs.translation: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
So, (O Prophet), persevere with gracious perseverance.
Verily they think that the chastisement is far off,
while We think that it is near at hand.
It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass,
and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool,
and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends

ayahs.arabicText: یُّبَصَّرُوْنَهُمْ١ؕ یَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ یَفْتَدِیْ مِنْ عَذَابِ یَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِیْهِۙ
ayahs.translation: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children,
and his spouse and his brother,
and his kinsfolk who had stood by him,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ جَمِیْعًا١ۙ ثُمَّ یُنْجِیْهِۙ
ayahs.translation: and all persons of the earth, if only he could thus save himself.
By no means! It will be the fierce flame
that will strip off the scalp.
It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated,
and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.
Verily man is impatient by nature:
bewailing when evil befalls him,
and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him,
except those that pray,
and are constant in their Prayer;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ فِیْۤ اَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُوْمٌ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: and those in whose wealth there is a known right
for those that ask and those that are dispossessed,
those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and fear the chastisement of their Lord –
surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from –
and those who guard their private parts,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا عَلٰۤى اَزْوَاجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَیْمَانُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَیْرُ مَلُوْمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess, for in regard to them they are not reproachable,

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنِ ابْتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعٰدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: but any who seeks to go beyond that, it is indeed they who are the transgressors,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمْ وَ عَهْدِهِمْ رٰعُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants,
and those who are upright in their testimonies;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عَلٰى صَلَاتِهِمْ یُحَافِظُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: and who take due care of their Prayer:
all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.
But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you

ayahs.arabicText: عَنِ الْیَمِیْنِ وَ عَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: in crowds, both on the right and on the left?

ayahs.arabicText: اَیَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ اَنْ یُّدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?
By no means! They know that which We have created them from.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَاۤ اُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشٰرِقِ وَ الْمَغٰرِبِ اِنَّا لَقٰدِرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power

ayahs.arabicText: عَلٰۤى اَنْ نُّبَدِّلَ خَیْرًا مِّنْهُمْ١ۙ وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوْقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ یَخُوْضُوْا وَ یَلْعَبُوْا حَتّٰى یُلٰقُوْا یَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِیْ یُوْعَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised,

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَاَنَّهُمْ اِلٰى نُصُبٍ یُّوْفِضُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves, as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.

ayahs.arabicText: خَاشِعَةً اَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ الْیَوْمُ الَّذِیْ كَانُوْا یُوْعَدُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.
